focus.name: interaction-spawn-late-level-object-family-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the seven late level-object and interaction handlers to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

handlers.name: InteractionSpawn_CreateType0FInteractionFacing_16
handlers.post_spawn: set spawned actor facing byte at offset 0x09

contracts: Selector 0x14 enters LevelObjectSpawnEntry with the established guard template.
Selector 0x3E is gated by 0x00FF7E21, creates the Type-0x0B level-event actor, and conditionally refreshes palette resource 0x00129532.
Selector 0x3C creates the Type-0x0C level-event actor, conditionally refreshes palette resource 0x001294F2, and writes 0x6000 to actor offset 0x1E for the 0x00FF7E26 == 5 case.
Selectors 0x26 and 0x16 forward-spawn the Type-0x0F interaction template; selector 0x16 additionally writes the spawned actor facing byte.
Selector 0x1C enters LevelObjectSpawnEntry with the Type-0x16 level-object template.
Selector 0xEA reverse-spawns the Type-0x36 interaction template.
evidence: Exact handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Established guard, level-event, Type-0x0F, Type-0x16, and Type-0x36 template records
limitations: The names identify exact runtime templates and direct handler behavior, not user-facing scene roles.
Dynamic reachability of the selectors remains unresolved.
